meta.scope: Bolivia batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core national statistical system from INE catalogue top-down: institutional identity, Encuesta de Hogares (poverty + labour), IPC, national accounts (recent base change), and Banco Central de Bolivia. Definition locked.
meta.strategy_note: Follows NEXT-COUNTRY-STRATEGY.md after Paraguay checkpoint. Note: national accounts base year updated to 2017 (SCN 2008) after ~30 years on 1990 base.

candidates.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) — institutional statistical identity
candidates.description: National statistical office of the Plurinational State of Bolivia. Produces the core official statistics (household surveys, poverty, prices, national accounts inputs, census, external trade, etc.).
referenced_by: All major INE programme methodologies and technical reports
Banco Central de Bolivia publications that cite INE sources
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Bolivian official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.

candidates.title: Encuesta de Hogares (EH) / Household Survey
candidates.description: Annual household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with urban/rural and departmental domains.
candidates.notes: Central social and labour survey. Official source for both labour statistics and monetary poverty. Conducted in the second half of each year; results feed the annual poverty and inequality publications.

candidates.title: Pobreza monetaria / Monetary poverty
candidates.description: Official income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence, calculated by comparing household per-capita income (from EH) with nationally defined poverty lines. Published with urban/rural and departmental breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Headline social indicator. Recent estimates place total monetary poverty in the mid-to-high 30% range and extreme poverty in the low teens, with large urban–rural gaps. Series updated with revised population projections (EPP Rev. 2025).

candidates.title: Líneas de pobreza y pobreza extrema
candidates.description: Monetary values of the moderate and extreme poverty lines (per capita), differentiated for urban and rural areas and updated with price information.
candidates.notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. Current methodology uses CBA 2015–2016 baskets; lines are published separately for urban and rural domains.

candidates.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services.
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic. Produced by INE. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco Central de Bolivia and into the updating of poverty lines. Recent inflation has been elevated relative to the long-run low-inflation period.

candidates.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Bolivia
candidates.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Major base-year revision completed in 2025 (new reference year 2017, SCN 2008).
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. After ~30 years on a 1990 base, the 2017 reference year and SCN 2008 adoption represent a structural upgrade (validated with CEPAL/FMI support). Quarterly and annual releases.

candidates.title: Banco Central de Bolivia — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
candidates.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange-rate developments, and the monetary programme.
candidates.notes: In the Bolivian division of labour INE leads prices, household surveys, poverty and national accounts; the BCB leads monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts monetary policy. Recent orientation has been contractive, aiming to bring inflation back to single digits and to rebuild reserves.

candidates.title: Programa Monetario del BCB
candidates.description: Annual monetary programme and periodic execution reports setting targets for monetary emission, net domestic credit and net international reserves.
candidates.notes: Operational policy framework. Recent programmes emphasise a contractive stance, open-market operations for sterilisation, and a gradual path toward greater exchange-rate flexibility and an inflation-targeting regime.

candidates.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys; underpins the revised population projections (EPP Rev. 2025).
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by EH design, poverty analysis and the 2025 population-projection revision used to reweight survey series.

candidates.title: Índice de Gini / Income inequality
candidates.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality calculated from EH income data. Companion indicator to the monetary-poverty series.
candidates.notes: Structural inequality measure. Published nationally and by urban/rural area alongside the annual poverty results.

proposed_edges.basis: Monetary poverty is calculated from EH household income data.
Poverty status is determined by comparing per-capita income with the official poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with price information derived from the IPC.
The monetary programme is a core policy product of the Banco Central de Bolivia.
EH is a core annual survey of INE.
IPC is produced and disseminated by INE.
The Gini coefficient is computed from the same income distribution underlying the poverty estimates.
National accounts are compiled under the INE statistical framework (with BCB collaboration on related series).
